name: DunSocial
description: DunSocial is a social media management platform for creating, scheduling, and managing social media content and engagement.

events.d: Lists social accounts connected to the DunSocial workspace.
Schedules a post to one or more connected social accounts.
Lists posts in the workspace with optional status and account filters.
Cancels a scheduled post before it publishes.
Creates a draft post without publishing.
